items.concern: Defensive, overloaded abstract and difficult first explanation
items.acceptance: Bilingual abstracts lead with problem, method and already observed findings; introduction explains proposal versus commit authority without front-loading disclaimer lists.

items.concern: Academic contribution and syntactic versus semantic authorization boundary
items.acceptance: Conditional operational set relation and knowledge/disclosure distinction, explicit assumptions, actual schema-only intervention, no claim of inventing component algorithms or executing XGrammar.

items.concern: Commercial platform integration presented as scientific novelty
items.acceptance: Confirm current contribution framing centers auditable authority and evidence boundaries, not the historical SaaS integration plan.

items.concern: G-KMS, SINE and arXiv:2510.13586 author placeholders
items.acceptance: Check current canonical bibliography and verified metadata; fix actual current defects only. Do not edit immutable early Paper A/B drafts or introduce irrelevant citations.
Do not use an unverified secondary record as a core current-paper comparison; confirm current treatment with exact bibliography/citation evidence.

items.concern: Industrial Zylos blog used as academic support
items.acceptance: Confirm current academic motivation does not depend on this industrial blog; no unsupported bibliographic replacement.

items.concern: MBTI alignment transferred to NPC voice stability
items.acceptance: No causal/personality/voice-benefit inference from MBTI questionnaire alignment; keep affect/style/voice outcomes separate from hard policy authorization.

items.concern: Circular gate-as-evaluator and missing proposal-repair-hold funnel
items.acceptance: Run frozen v2 main cases in four actual arms. Evaluate initial and repaired final candidates using an implementation-separated reference on PRE-ACTION state; report raw invalid, repair recovery, terminal holds, goals and failures with explicit separate denominators.

Measure false rejection against reference-valid initial cases; report exact structural-signature retention and separate repaired signature counts. Do not interpret these as creative quality, linguistic diversity or human ratings.

Run separately denominated paired bilingual surface sentinels; explain structured-fact gate versus unrestricted narrative implications and controlled-template emission. No invented NLI mechanism, model-generated leakage prevalence or renderer-level safety result.

items.concern: Missing typed placement/edge graph and independent reachability validation
items.acceptance: Freeze typed finite bidirectional reusable-key graphs and placements; compare a distinct closure with BFS over location/inventory. Explain that canonical WorldState consumes authoritative reachable_locations rather than inferring edges from entity-name strings; no full-game playability claim.

items.concern: Multi-LLM, multi-scenario generalization and filling TODO-RESULT
items.acceptance: Execute the new multi-scenario deterministic audit without relabeling it as LLM evidence. Preserve old assignment denominators, all C-RESULT TODO-RESULT and blocked prospective 0/180. State that no new admitted multi-model/human efficacy collection was performed; do not fabricate such values or bypass identity, billing, isolation or protocol gates.
